knownLimitations: Class I historical editorial associations are not necessarily final approval for the new requested date; user-specific overrides preserved separately.
Class II I/II research from PR #2138 remains conservative; some newly sourced painting names are not yet in 383 inventory. Unmatched means unlinked in this inventory only.
Class III subject-index links are based on explicit saint identity in artwork title and name aliases; each still requires exact object, role, user rating, image rights and crop verification.
Group saints must not be marked complete from a single group-member portrait. This master retains no automatic group completion.
Actual Mass Gospel image correspondence and movable date/church-local transfer are not inferred from Sunday title.
No Class IV observed principal saint dates in canonical 2026. Do not commission 71 independent pictures for feria dates.
Research image files acquired and SHA-verified are not by themselves granted app licences.
Prior 75-priority saint-source programme and later art approvals not in the 383 index still need cross-module matching before claiming art physically absent.
Where a physical painting has two catalogue IDs the exact original must be deduplicated before rotating.

Class II missing exact 383 matches includes a handful of already approved cross-module primaries (e.g. Lotto Rosary, MNAC Seven Sorrows), and anticipatory selected artwork reuse; specific date binding has not been user-approved.

At least one unmatched group day already has a member-specific physical painting: 20 Jan has Saint Sebastian artworks but no verified exact joint Fabian/Sebastian composition. Separate partialGroupSaintPaintingLeads records preserve reuse without claiming group completion.
Research Batch 1 matches 12 Class III dates to 17 previously accepted 856-source photos; source acceptance is not an artwork-to-feast approval, image rights, source SHA or live publication.
Class II contextual anticipatory source choices and partial Group Saints do NOT count as complete exact date bindings.

Class I Batch 3 adds exact institution/object-accession research for existing selected paintings where B05/B11/B17/B18/B21 already document them. Does not establish user's exact approved photo pixels, app rights, or crop; the Morgan Tissot and Carracci All Souls remain blocked.

Batch4 uses W72 older human scores as recorded, not overriding canonical artwork editorial statuses or granting a feast-specific selection. Accepted-source KMSKA Boniface has explicit old human identity doubt.
Seven Servite Founders AIC Masucci exact named file and Commons CC0 identified; no photo native SHA or crop QA certified. All seven new subject dates remain editorial research only.
